overview: Ralltiir is a star system in the Core Worlds, within the Darpa Sector, at galactic grid L-9, Documented in the Essential Atlas and StarWars.com galaxy map appendix..
history:
Ralltiir appears in galactic surveys spanning the Old Republic, Imperial era, and New Republic periods. Essential Atlas records place the system in Core Worlds.

Trade lanes, sector politics, and regional conflicts shaped Ralltiir's role across the nine saga films, live-action series, and expanded lore.
significance: Ralltiir is catalogued on the official StarWars.com galaxy map and Essential Atlas appendix as part of the broader Core Worlds chart.
notableEvents: Charted in the Essential Atlas appendix
Listed on the StarWars.com galaxy map
Surveyed as part of Core Worlds sector records
